A. Encouragement — a life worthy of the kingdom of God (1:3-12)

verses.text: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.marked_text: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
outlines: II. The content — encouragement and correction concerning the holy life for the church (1:3—3:15)
A. Encouragement — a life worthy of the kingdom of God (1:3-12)

verses.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.marked_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: We ought to thank God always concerning you, brothers, even as it is fitting, because your faith grows exceedingly and the love of each one of you all to one another is increasing,
verses.marked_text: We ought to thank God always concerning you, brothers, even as it is fitting, because your faith grows exceedingly and the love of each one of you all to one another is increasing,

verses.text: So that we ourselves boast in you among the churches of God concerning your endurance and faith in all your persecutions and the afflictions which you bear,
verses.marked_text: So that we ourselves boast in you among the churches of God concerning your endurance and faith in all your persecutions and the afflictions which you bear,

verses.text: A plain indication of the righteous judgment of God, that you may be accounted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which also you suffer;
verses.marked_text: A plain indication of the righteous judgment of God, that you may be accounted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which also you suffer;

verses.text: Since it is just with God to repay with affliction those afflicting you,
verses.marked_text: Since it is just with God to repay with affliction those afflicting you,

verses.text: And to you who are being afflicted, rest with us at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with the angels of His power, in flaming fire,
verses.marked_text: And to you who are being afflicted, rest with us at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with the angels of His power, in flaming fire,

verses.text: Rendering vengeance to those who do not know God and to those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ .
verses.marked_text: Rendering vengeance to those who do not know God and to those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.text: They will pay the penalty of eternal destruction from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of His strength
verses.marked_text: They will pay the penalty of eternal destruction from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of His strength

verses.text: When He comes to be glorified in His saints and to be marveled at in all those who have believed (because our testimony to you was believed) in that day.
verses.marked_text: When He comes to be glorified in His saints and to be marveled at in all those who have believed (because our testimony to you was believed) in that day.

verses.text: For which also we pray always concerning you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling and may fulfill in power your every good intention for goodness and your work of faith,
verses.marked_text: For which also we pray always concerning you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling and may fulfill in power your every good intention for goodness and your work of faith,

verses.text: So that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.marked_text: So that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

footnotes.text: See note 1 Thes. 1:1 1c .
See note 1 Thes. 1:1 2 .

The endurance issued from and was supported by the hope of the Lord's coming back ( 1 Thes. 1:3 ). Such endurance resulting from hope is always accompanied by faith. Hence, the phrase endurance and faith is used here. Both endurance and faith are needed in persecutions and afflictions.

God's judgment is righteous and just upon all men. It will be finalized in the future ( Rom. 2:5-9 ; Rev. 20:11-15 ). The way God deals with different people in this age is an indication, a token, a proof, of the future execution of His righteous judgment.

Or, relief, ease, repose, liberty. In this age the believers suffer persecutions and troubles for the Lord. At the Lord's coming back they will be relieved of their sufferings and will enter into the Lord's rest and enjoy its liberty.
Some MSS omit, Christ.
Lit., face.
Or, delight. The apostles prayed that God might fulfill the good intention, the delight, of the Thessalonians for goodness.

The grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ is the Lord Himself within us as our life and life supply that we may live a life that will glorify the Lord and cause us to be glorified in Him. See note John 1:17 1a , note 1 Cor. 15:10 1a , and note 2 Cor. 13:14 1a .

outlines.text: B. Correction — the misconception concerning the day of the Lord's coming (2:1-12)

verses.text: Now we ask you, brothers, with regard to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to Him,
verses.marked_text: Now we ask you, brothers, with regard to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to Him,
outlines: B. Correction — the misconception concerning the day of the Lord's coming (2:1-12)

verses.text: That you be not quickly shaken in mind nor alarmed, neither by a spirit nor by word nor by a letter as if by us, to the effect that the day of the Lord has come.
verses.marked_text: That you be not quickly shaken in mind nor alarmed, neither by a spirit nor by word nor by a letter as if by us, to the effect that the day of the Lord has come.

verses.text: Let no one deceive you in any way, because it will not come unless the apostasy comes first and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of perdition,
verses.marked_text: Let no one deceive you in any way, because it will not come unless the apostasy comes first and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of perdition,

verses.text: Who opposes and exalts himself above all that is called God or an object of worship, so that he sits in the temple of God, setting himself forth, saying that he is God.
verses.marked_text: Who opposes and exalts himself above all that is called God or an object of worship, so that he sits in the temple of God, setting himself forth, saying that he is God.

verses.text: Do you not remember that while I was still with you, I said these things to you?
verses.marked_text: Do you not remember that while I was still with you, I said these things to you?

verses.text: And now you know that which restrains , so that he might be revealed in his own time .
verses.marked_text: And now you know that which restrains , so that he might be revealed in his own time .

verses.text: For it is the mystery of lawlessness that is now operating, but only until the one now restraining goes out of the way.
verses.marked_text: For it is the mystery of lawlessness that is now operating, but only until the one now restraining goes out of the way.

verses.text: And then the lawless one will be revealed (whom the Lord Jesus will slay by the breath of His mouth and bring to nothing by the manifestation of His coming ),
verses.marked_text: And then the lawless one will be revealed (whom the Lord Jesus will slay by the breath of His mouth and bring to nothing by the manifestation of His coming ),

verses.text: The coming of whom is according to Satan's operation in all power and signs and wonders of a lie
verses.marked_text: The coming of whom is according to Satan's operation in all power and signs and wonders of a lie

verses.text: And in all deceit of unrighteousness among those who are perishing, because they did not receive the love of the truth that they might be saved.
verses.marked_text: And in all deceit of unrighteousness among those who are perishing, because they did not receive the love of the truth that they might be saved.

verses.text: And because of this God sends to them an operation of error that they might believe the lie,
verses.marked_text: And because of this God sends to them an operation of error that they might believe the lie,

verses.text: So that all who have not believed the truth but have taken pleasure in unrighteousness might be judged.
verses.marked_text: So that all who have not believed the truth but have taken pleasure in unrighteousness might be judged.

verses.text: But we ought to thank God always concerning you, brothers beloved of the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning unto salvation in sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth,
verses.marked_text: But we ought to thank God always concerning you, brothers beloved of the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning unto salvation in sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth,

verses.text: To which also He called you through our gospel unto the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.marked_text: To which also He called you through our gospel unto the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold to the things which were handed down to you and which you were taught, whether by word or by our letter.
verses.marked_text: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold to the things which were handed down to you and which you were taught, whether by word or by our letter.

verses.text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope in grace ,
verses.marked_text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope in grace ,

verses.text: Comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
verses.marked_text: Comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

footnotes.text: Or, on behalf of.
Lit., toward.
Lit., from the mind; i.e., "from a steady and soberly judging mind" (Darby).
See note 1 Thes. 5:2 2c .
Or, beguile; "not only making a false impression, but actually leading astray" (Vincent).

Antichrist, as prophesied in Dan. 7:20-21 , 24-26 ; 9:27 ; 11:36-37 ; Rev. 13:1-8 , 12-18 ; 19:19-20 . He will be the man of lawlessness and will change laws, destroy and corrupt many to an extraordinary degree, blaspheme God, and deceive men. Hence, the Lord will utterly destroy him, and he will become the son of perdition.
This refers to some power that hinders the revelation of the man of lawlessness, Antichrist.
The time appointed by God, which will be the last of the seventy weeks, as prophesied in Dan. 9:27 ; 7:24-26 ; Rev. 13:1-8 .
The lawlessness that will characterize Antichrist ( v. 3 ) is already operating in this age mysteriously. It is the mystery of lawlessness working today among the nations and in human society.
This probably means that the restraining one is taken out of the way.
This will be fulfilled in Rev. 19:19-20 .

Or, shining forth. This indicates that the Lord's coming (parousia) will be hidden before it is manifested openly (see note Matt. 24:27 1 ). This indicates also that the Lord's coming will last a period of time (see note 2 Thes. 2:1 2a ). First, it will be in secret, and then it will be manifested to the public.
As prophesied in Rev. 13:2 , 4 , 7 .
The entire operation of Satan to deceive people ( v. 10 ) is in its totality a lie, just as he is a liar and the father of liars ( John 8:44 ).

Because the perishing ones did not receive the love of the truth, which God intended to give them that they might be saved ( v. 10 ), God sends to them an operation of error, an active power of misleading, that they might believe the lie.

The believers have a good intention for goodness ( 2 Thes. 1:11 ); the perishing ones ( v. 10 ), who reject the truth of God, take pleasure in unrighteousness. To sin is a delight to them ( Rom. 1:32 ).
I.e., from eternity past (cf. Eph. 1:4 ). Some ancient MSS read, as firstfruits.

Or, faith. By the Spirit's sanctification God's salvation is revealed and brought to us; by our believing we receive all that is revealed and brought to us by the Spirit, so that we obtain God's salvation.

Referring to salvation in sanctification ...and belief...in the preceding verse. God chose us unto salvation in eternity, and then in time He called us unto the obtaining of the glory of our Lord. Salvation in sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth is the procedure; the obtaining of the glory of our Lord is the goal.
Our Lord Jesus Christ and God the Father work together to comfort and establish the believers ( v. 17 ).
Not temporary and transitory comfort and strengthening but eternal comfort by the divine life. This comfort is sufficient for any kind of environment and situation; thus, it is with good hope.
The hope of glory ( Col. 1:27 ), which is the hope of the Lord's coming ( 1 Thes. 1:3 ), when we will be either resurrected or transfigured into glory ( 1 Thes. 4:13-14 ; Phil. 3:21 ; Heb. 2:10 ).
God Himself in Christ for us to enjoy (see note John 1:17 1a ) that we may be sanctified by His Spirit ( v. 13 ) and comforted and established ( v. 17 ) with eternal comfort and good hope.

verses.text: Finally , brothers, pray concerning us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified , even as it is also with you;
verses.marked_text: Finally , brothers, pray concerning us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified , even as it is also with you;
outlines: D. Correction concerning those walking disorderly (3:6-15)

verses.text: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men, for the faith does not belong to all.
verses.marked_text: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men, for the faith does not belong to all.

verses.text: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
verses.marked_text: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

verses.text: And we have confidence in the Lord concerning you that what we charge , you both are doing and will do.
verses.marked_text: And we have confidence in the Lord concerning you that what we charge , you both are doing and will do.

verses.text: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God and into the endurance of Christ.
verses.marked_text: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God and into the endurance of Christ.

verses.text: Now we charge you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you keep away from every brother walking disorderly and not according to the things which were handed down to you and which you received from us.
verses.marked_text: Now we charge you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you keep away from every brother walking disorderly and not according to the things which were handed down to you and which you received from us.

verses.text: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not disorderly among you;
verses.marked_text: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not disorderly among you;

verses.text: Nor did we eat bread as a gift from anyone, but in labor and hardship we worked night and day so that we would not be burdensome to any of you;
verses.marked_text: Nor did we eat bread as a gift from anyone, but in labor and hardship we worked night and day so that we would not be burdensome to any of you;

verses.text: Not because we do not have the right, but in order that we might give ourselves to you as a pattern that you might imitate us.
verses.marked_text: Not because we do not have the right, but in order that we might give ourselves to you as a pattern that you might imitate us.

verses.text: For even when we were with you, we gave you this charge, that if anyone does not want to work, neither should he eat.
verses.marked_text: For even when we were with you, we gave you this charge, that if anyone does not want to work, neither should he eat.

verses.text: For we hear of some walking among you disorderly, doing no work at all, but being busybodies .
verses.marked_text: For we hear of some walking among you disorderly, doing no work at all, but being busybodies .

verses.text: Now such ones we charge and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ to work with quietness and eat their own bread.
verses.marked_text: Now such ones we charge and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ to work with quietness and eat their own bread.

verses.text: But you, brothers, do not lose heart in doing good.
verses.marked_text: But you, brothers, do not lose heart in doing good.

verses.text: And if anyone does not obey our word through this letter, mark this one so as not to mingle with him, in order that he may be ashamed.
verses.marked_text: And if anyone does not obey our word through this letter, mark this one so as not to mingle with him, in order that he may be ashamed.

verses.text: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
verses.marked_text: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

verses.text: Now the Lord of peace Himself give you peace continually in every way. The Lord be with you all.
verses.marked_text: Now the Lord of peace Himself give you peace continually in every way. The Lord be with you all.

verses.text: The greeting in my own hand — Paul — which is the mark in every letter; so I write.
verses.marked_text: The greeting in my own hand — Paul — which is the mark in every letter; so I write.

verses.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
verses.marked_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

footnotes.text: To have the divine riches contained in the word of the Lord released and expressed in the believers' living.
Lit., toward.
The entire world lies in the evil one ( 1 John 5:19 ), but the divine life, which we have by being born of God, keeps and guards us from him ( 4 , 1 John 5:18 ; 3:8-9 ).
I.e., to love God with the love of God that we have enjoyed and experienced.
I.e., to endure with the endurance of Christ that we have enjoyed and experienced.

On the positive side, we need to enjoy the love of God that we may love Him in order to live for Him, and on the negative side, we need to participate in the endurance of Christ that we may endure sufferings, as He did, to stand against Satan, the enemy of God. Loving God and enduring sufferings are excellent characteristics of a Christian living.

See note 14 1 in 1 Thes. 5 . Cf. vv. 7 , 11 . To walk disorderly not only is according to the flesh ( Rom. 8:4 ) but also is against the building up of the church life ( 1 Thes. 5:11 ; Rom. 14:19 ; 1 Cor. 10:23 ).
The apostles were for the building up of the church in all things ( 2 Cor. 12:19 ); they were absolutely not disorderly among the believers but were a pattern for the believers to imitate ( v. 9 ).
